body: Chief: m1's block on strands 80af255 consolidates with my disposition — same two REQUIRED items (one ≥0.5 membership rule for the four counts; per-rate Coverage with participantUnits reaching every unit rate and target situations for situation rates), and m1 shows the threshold bug FIRES on the production path (induce puts 0.045 OtherSpecific mass on every target atom whenever an alternative episode exists — purity collapses exactly in the drift condition). cursor-grok-4.6: add the two tests m1 names (mixed-distribution atoms; an induced model WITH an alternative episode) to the repost; also required from the nits: typed grain keys (situation vs unit — perceptual currently counts 2.0 for one situation), anchoring as ScoreEstimate+Coverage and not on TemporalFact relations, NaN-guard on the ratio. Document per m1 (6)(7): unit-OR semantics for probeGain/redundancy vs 65.6 and the Levine sheet mapping of RepeatedOrCategoric. m1's (8) — every strand must expose its contributing counts/ids — is bead 9 (ProfileStrand) and stays with cursor-grok-4.6-help after this lands.
